name: AWS IMDS: SSRF -> role -> session keys -> takeover
goal: Turn a same-origin SSRF into live AWS session credentials for the instance profile.
preconditions: A parameter or header that makes the server issue HTTP requests (or read file:// paths); EC2 deployment without IMDSv2 hop limit enforcement.
impact: Live AKIA/ASIA session keys for the instance role -> S3/EC2/STS actions in the role's scope; combined with public bucket listing this is direct data-plane takeover.

steps.purpose: Prove the sink at the strongest primitive (file://) and fingerprint the host (cloud-init, /etc/passwd, hostname).
steps.on_success: Record the sink; try http:// against 169.254.169.254 through the same sink.
steps.on_fail: file:// blocked but http:// works -> go straight to step 2; neither works -> pivot to chain multi-cloud-metadata-sweep for header-based providers.

steps.purpose: Read /latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/ to learn the attached role name.
steps.on_success: Save the role name as the {{role_name}} input of step 3.
steps.on_fail: 401 on IMDS = IMDSv2 token required -> try X-aws-ec2-metadata-token header injection via web/CRLF response-header injection; GCP/Azure instead -> multi-cloud-metadata-sweep.

steps.purpose: Dump the role's AccessKeyId/SecretAccessKey/Token = live session credentials.
steps.on_success: Validate scope with a cheap ListBuckets/GetCallerIdentity call; pivot to redteam/S3-GCS public bucket listing for the data plane.
steps.on_fail: Keys present but scoped-down -> keep them as evidence, sweep other SSRF sinks for other roles; redteam/.env dotenv secrets exposure may hold static keys.

entry_points: import-from-URL (avatars, Google-Sheets style import, CMS media by URL)

recon.name: Parameter wordlist fuzz on sinks
recon.how: FFUF the collected endpoint list with canary URL values in every candidate parameter.
recon.signal: Canary callback or response containing canary content.

recon.name: Wayback parameter mining
recon.how: Pull historical URLs, grep for fetch-shaped parameters, replay them at the live host.
recon.signal: Old endpoints still alive are untested by dev.

recon.name: Internal port scan via latency
recon.how: Time requests to 127.0.0.1:N through the sink; open ports answer fast or differently.

recon.name: IMDS address variants
recon.how: Try 169.254.169.254, 169.254.169.254.nip.io, decimal/hex/IPv6 encodings to slip past blocklists.
recon.signal: Blocklist bypass when one encoding returns data others 403.

recon.name: Header-based metadata triggers
recon.how: Inject Metadata-Flavor / Metadata / X-aws-ec2-metadata-token headers where the sink forwards client headers.
recon.signal: GCP/Azure metadata JSON in the response.

variants: SSRF in SAML IdP metadata fetch
SSRF in image/media processors via URL
pivot_hints: Session keys -> assume-role across accounts in the org
role name reveals workload -> enumerate sibling instances via same stack (favicon clustering)
no cloud creds? file:// read of ~/.aws/credentials or /var/lib/kubelet/... configs
